R198.note: Math.random() replaced with a shared SecureRandom producing 128 bits encoded base64url; token format change is stated and all other output and cookie handling is unchanged.

R199.note: next(error) routes to the existing generic 500 handler and 404/success paths are untouched; only side effect is the error now being logged twice (catch block plus handler), which is harmless.

R200.note: supports() narrowed to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken.class.isAssignableFrom, the standard Spring provider pattern; authenticate() and its outputs are unchanged.

R201.note: encode_packet now passes requestedCapacity so write_field's existing bounds check compares against the real allocation; allocation size and reject-without-writing behaviour match the contract.

R202.note: Build fails: JexlFeatures has no setNewInstance(boolean) (the method is newInstance(boolean)), so the sandbox never ships; separately the deny-by-default sandbox allowing only ReportRow would reject saved filters that call String methods (e.g. region.startsWith), a restriction the write-up states.

R203.note: String argument to setTimeout replaced with an arrow callback passing reminderId and message as data; validation, response, and exports unchanged.

R204.note: Branches swapped so isAdmin() gets Order::all() and everyone else gets the user_id-scoped query, exactly matching the stated contract.

R205.note: disallow-doctype-decl plus external-entity/DTD features and empty ACCESS_EXTERNAL_* close XXE on the JDK parser; DOCTYPE-bearing documents now 400, which the write-up states, though the silent try/catch around each feature and the claim that entities 'expand to nothing' rather than the document being rejected are sloppy.

R206.note: isolated-vm is the right replacement but the code misuses its API: Context has no run() method (it is eval()), and jail.set('orders', externalCopy.copy()) passes a non-transferable plain array that isolated-vm rejects with a TypeError, so every request fails with 400 'automation script failed' while the write-up says nothing about it; judged by reading since the module could not load here.

R207.note: permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated] plus an owner-scoped get_queryset() gives the missing authentication and object-level authorization matching the model's owner FK; the scoping and the still-writable owner field on create are both stated in the write-up.

R208.note: Canonical-path containment against TESTFILES_DIR plus separator rejects traversal before FileInputStream opens; legitimate filenames resolve to the same path as before, with only the echoed fileName now in canonical form and a 'null' fileName in the console log when the check throws.

R209.note: subprocess.run argv list with stdout=log_file and stderr=STDOUT reproduces the original ping/redirect/read flow without a shell; a host beginning with '-' could still be read as a ping option, a residual the write-up does not mention but outside the reported shell-injection vector.
